name: io.github.mod8l/perceive8
title: Perceive8
description: Meeting intelligence in your AI assistant — analyses, transcripts, reports, alerts, Aria.

tools.name: list_analyses
tools.description:
List your meeting analyses.

        Returns a paginated list of your audio/video analyses sorted by most recent.
        Each analysis represents one recorded meeting or call.

        Args:
            limit: Maximum number of analyses to return (1-100, default 20).
            offset: Pagination offset (default 0).

tools.name: get_analysis
tools.description:
Get detailed information about a specific analysis.

        Returns metadata, processing runs, and optionally audio intelligence
        (emotions, sentiment, topics) for a meeting analysis.

        Args:
            analysis_id: UUID of the analysis.
            include_audio_intelligence: If true, include emotion/sentiment/topic data.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description:
Get the full transcript of a meeting.

        Returns the complete transcript with speaker labels and timestamps.

        Args:
            analysis_id: UUID of the analysis.
            format: Output format — 'markdown' (default) or 'json'.

tools.name: search_transcripts
tools.description:
Search across meeting transcripts using natural language.

        Uses RAG (semantic search + LLM) to find and answer questions about
        your meetings. Can search across all meetings or within a specific one.

        If this returns no sources, check the diagnostic note in the response:
        when 0 segments are indexed, semantic search cannot match anything —
        fall back to `keyword_search_transcripts` for literal text search or
        `get_transcript` to read a specific meeting directly. Also prefer
        `keyword_search_transcripts` for exact names, jargon, or non-English
        terms (e.g. Hebrew) that semantic search can miss.

        Args:
            question: Your question about the meetings
                (e.g., "What did Sarah say about the timeline?").
            analysis_id: Optional — limit search to a specific analysis.
            scenario_id: Optional — provide scenario context for more relevant answers.

tools.name: keyword_search_transcripts
tools.description:
Search meeting transcripts for an exact word or phrase (case-insensitive).

        Matches literal text only — no paraphrases. Use this when
        `search_transcripts` returns nothing, or when looking for exact names,
        jargon, or non-English terms (e.g. Hebrew) that semantic search can miss.

        Args:
            query: The exact word or phrase to find.
            analysis_id: Optional — limit search to a specific analysis.
            limit: Maximum matches to return (1-200, default 50).

tools.name: generate_report
tools.description:
Generate an AI report for a meeting analysis.

        Creates a detailed report by analyzing the transcript against a scenario's
        questions and criteria. Reports include executive summary, findings,
        concerns, recommendations, and timeline highlights.

        Args:
            analysis_id: UUID of the analysis to report on.
            scenario_id: UUID of the scenario (use case) to evaluate against.
            wait: If true (default), wait for the report to complete
                (up to 90s). If false, return immediately with the
                report ID for polling.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description:
Get a previously generated report.

        Returns the full report with executive summary, findings, concerns,
        recommendations, and cost/token details.

        Args:
            report_id: UUID of the report.

tools.name: list_reports
tools.description:
List your generated reports.

        Returns all reports, optionally filtered to a specific analysis.

        Args:
            analysis_id: Optional — filter to reports for this analysis.

tools.name: get_report_sections
tools.description:
Get structured sections of a report.

        Returns specific sections (executive_summary, timeline, concerns,
        recommendations, speaker_analysis) of a generated report.

        Args:
            report_id: UUID of the report.
            section_type: Optional — filter to a specific section type.

tools.name: get_report_status
tools.description:
Check the generation status of a report.

        Useful for polling async report generation progress.

        Args:
            report_id: UUID of the report.

tools.name: list_scenario_templates
tools.description:
List available scenario templates.

        Scenario templates are pre-built analysis frameworks like
        'Sales Discovery', 'Customer Support QA', 'Interview Assessment', etc.
        Clone a template to create your own customized scenario.

tools.name: list_scenarios
tools.description:
List all your scenarios (built-in + custom).

        Scenarios define what to look for in a meeting — they contain a set
        of questions/criteria that are evaluated against the transcript.

tools.name: get_scenario
tools.description:
Get full details of a scenario including all its questions.

        Args:
            scenario_id: UUID of the scenario.

tools.name: clone_scenario_from_template
tools.description:
Clone a scenario template as your own custom scenario.

        Creates a copy of a system template that you can then customize.

        Args:
            template_id: UUID of the template to clone.
            name: Optional custom name for the cloned scenario.

tools.name: list_builtin_skills
tools.description:
List built-in analysis skills.

        Skills are AI capabilities like MeetingAnalystSkill,
        TranscriptAnalystSkill, ResultsAnalystSkill, etc. that power
        Perceive8's analysis engine.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description:
List all available skills (built-in + custom).

        Returns both system skills and any custom skills you've created.

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description:
List alerts for an analysis.

        Alerts are real-time scenario violations detected during a meeting
        (e.g., HIGH severity concern about pricing, WARNING about compliance).

        Args:
            analysis_id: UUID of the analysis.
            acknowledged: Optional — filter by acknowledged status (true/false).
            severity: Optional — filter by severity level (INFO, WARNING, HIGH, CRITICAL).

tools.name: acknowledge_alert
tools.description:
Acknowledge an alert.

        Mark an alert as acknowledged so it's no longer flagged as pending.

        Args:
            alert_id: UUID of the alert to acknowledge.

tools.name: subscribe_alert_notifications
tools.description:
Subscribe to real-time alert notifications for a meeting analysis.

        After subscribing, the server will poll for new alerts and send
        notifications/resources/updated events when new alerts are detected.
        The client can then read the updated perceive8://alerts/stream/{analysis_id}
        resource to get the full list of new alerts.

        This implements #245 — real-time alert notifications via MCP resource polling.

        Args:
            analysis_id: UUID of the analysis to monitor for new alerts.

tools.name: unsubscribe_alert_notifications
tools.description:
Unsubscribe from real-time alert notifications for a meeting analysis.

        Args:
            analysis_id: UUID of the analysis to stop monitoring.

tools.name: ask_aria
tools.description:
Ask Perceive8's AI assistant (Aria) a question about your meetings.

        Aria is an expert meeting analyst that can answer questions about
        completed reports, transcripts, and analysis results. It uses the
        full context of the report (findings, sections, windows, scenario)
        to provide detailed, evidence-backed answers.

        For multi-turn conversations, provide the conversation_id from a
        previous response.

        Args:
            question: Your question for Aria (e.g., "What were the main concerns in this meeting?").
            report_id: UUID of the report to ask about. Required for first message.
            conversation_id: Optional — continue an existing conversation thread.

tools.name: ask_aria_workspace
tools.description:
Ask Aria a question about your workspace / account.

        Aria acts as an account assistant with access to your workspace data
        (business profile, connected integrations, suggested integrations,
        boards, tasks, forms, calendar, workspace files) and can perform
        actions such as scheduling meetings or running agent tasks.

        For follow-up messages, provide the conversation_id returned by a
        previous call.

        Args:
            question: Your question or request for Aria (e.g. "What integrations
                did you suggest I connect?" or "Schedule a follow-up meeting
                with Acme tomorrow at 2pm").
            conversation_id: Optional — continue an existing workspace-assistant
                conversation thread.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description:
List your recent Aria conversation threads.

        Returns your most recent conversations with Aria, grouped by type
        (results_analyst, transcript_analyst, data_analyst, workspace_assistant, etc.).

tools.name: prepare_meeting_briefing
tools.description:
Prepare a briefing for an upcoming meeting with a person or company.

        Searches across your recent analyses to find all meetings involving
        the specified person/company, then aggregates summaries, open action
        items, concerns, and sentiment trends into a concise briefing.

        Args:
            person: Name of the person to search for across meetings.
            company: Name of the company to search for across meetings.
            max_meetings: Maximum number of meetings to include (default 10).
            days_back: How far back to search in days (default 90).

tools.name: weekly_digest
tools.description:
Generate a weekly digest of all your meetings.

        Aggregates all meetings from the specified period, pulling reports
        and summaries to create a consolidated digest with total time,
        key decisions, action items, and concerns.

        Args:
            days_back: Number of days to look back (default 7).
            scenario_id: Optional — filter to meetings using a specific scenario.

tools.name: find_action_items
tools.description:
Find action items across all recent meetings.

        Reads the action items and recommendations that meeting reports
        extracted at generation time, so it works even when semantic search
        has nothing indexed. A semantic search over transcripts is added as a
        best-effort supplement when available.

        Args:
            days_back: How far back to search in days (default 30).
            owner: Optional — filter action items by owner/assignee name.

tools.name: get_business_profile
tools.description:
Get the account's business profile.

        The business profile is account-level: one profile owned by the
        account and shared across all of its workspaces (there is no
        per-workspace profile). Returns the company profile, employees,
        products, competitors, and auto-setup status.

tools.name: create_business_profile
tools.description:
Create the account-level business profile if it does not already exist.

        The business profile is shared across all workspaces of the account.
        If a profile already exists, the existing profile is returned unchanged.
        Owner-only.

        Args:
            name: Company name.
            website_url: Company website URL.
            industry: Industry or vertical.
            company_size: Company size range, e.g. "11-50".
            country: Country code or name.
            language: Language code, e.g. "en".
            description: Company description.
            value_proposition: Value proposition.
            ideal_customer_profile: JSON object describing the ideal customer.
            key_objectives: List of business objectives.
            sales_motion: One of "transactional", "enterprise", "self-serve", "hybrid".
            tone_of_voice: Brand tone of voice.

tools.name: plan_auto_setup
tools.description:
Generate a read-only automatic account setup plan.

        Proposes workspaces, boards, agents, and invites based on the business
        profile. Nothing is created; use `apply_auto_setup` to apply the plan.

        Owner-only.

tools.name: apply_auto_setup
tools.description:
Apply the automatic account setup plan.

        Runs website enrichment, auto-accepts playbook recommendations, creates
        starter workspace files, and links employees. This is idempotent and
        owner-only.

tools.name: reset_business_profile
tools.description:
Reset the account's business profile.

        Deletes the account-level profile (shared across all workspaces) and
        all related employees, products, competitors, sources, and
        recommendations. Workspaces, boards, agents, and sent invites survive.
        Owner-only and destructive.

tools.name: enrich_business_profile
tools.description:
Enrich the business profile from its website.

        Scrapes the website URL, extracts structured profile fields, and writes
        them to the business profile. Only blank fields are filled.

        Args:
            website_url: Optional URL to enrich from. If omitted, the profile's
                stored website URL is used.

tools.name: register_business_file
tools.description:
Register a file in Supabase Storage as a business source.

        The file must already be uploaded to the workspace-files bucket under
        `{workspace_id}/business-uploads/...`. This endpoint records it in the
        business profile so Aria and the Files page can use it.

        Args:
            storage_path: Full storage path, e.g. `{workspace_id}/business-uploads/...`.
            filename: Human-readable filename.

tools.name: list_workspace_files
tools.description:
List workspace documents and presentations.

        Args:
            workspace_id: Optional workspace UUID. If omitted, the active
                workspace from the API key is used.
            include_archived: Include archived files.

tools.name: get_workspace_file
tools.description:
Get a workspace document or presentation, including its content.

        Args:
            file_id: UUID of the workspace file.

tools.name: create_workspace_file
tools.description:
Create a new workspace document or presentation.

        Args:
            title: Title of the file.
            file_type: 'document' or 'presentation'.

tools.name: update_workspace_file
tools.description:
Update a workspace file's metadata.

        Args:
            file_id: UUID of the file.
            title: New title.
            is_archived: Archive or unarchive the file.

tools.name: delete_workspace_file
tools.description:
Delete a workspace file.

        Args:
            file_id: UUID of the file.

tools.name: edit_workspace_file
tools.description:
Apply an AI co-pilot edit to a workspace file.

        Args:
            file_id: UUID of the file.
            instruction: Natural language instruction describing the desired edit.

tools.name: list_workspace_file_versions
tools.description:
List versions of a workspace file.

        Args:
            file_id: UUID of the file.

tools.name: restore_workspace_file_version
tools.description:
Restore a workspace file to a previous version.

        Args:
            file_id: UUID of the file.
            version: Version number to restore.

tools.name: export_workspace_file
tools.description:
Export a workspace file to a portable format.

        Args:
            file_id: UUID of the file.
            file_format: 'markdown', 'pdf', or 'html' (availability depends on file type).

tools.name: get_workspace_file_templates
tools.description: List available workspace file templates.

tools.name: analyze_text
tools.description:
Analyze a block of text synchronously.

        Creates a single-segment analysis, runs the text pipeline, and returns
        the analysis. Useful for analyzing short transcripts or chat logs
        without uploading a file.

        Args:
            text: The text to analyze.
            language: Language code (default 'en').
            speaker: Speaker label for the single segment (default 'Person').

tools.name: list_text_uploads
tools.description:
List text-only analyses for the workspace.

        Args:
            limit: Maximum number of uploads (1-100).
            offset: Pagination offset.

tools.name: get_text_upload_status
tools.description:
Get the processing status of a text upload or analysis.

        Args:
            analysis_id: UUID of the text analysis.

tools.name: get_text_upload_result
tools.description:
Get the transcript and report from a text upload/analysis.

        Args:
            analysis_id: UUID of the text analysis.

tools.name: list_agent_monitoring_alerts
tools.description:
List agent monitoring alerts for the workspace.

        Args:
            severity: Optional filter by severity (e.g. 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical').
            alert_type: Optional filter by alert type.
            acknowledged: Filter by acknowledged status.
            limit: Maximum number of alerts (1-200).
            offset: Pagination offset.

tools.name: get_agent_monitoring_alert_stats
tools.description: Get dashboard statistics for agent monitoring alerts.

tools.name: acknowledge_agent_monitoring_alert
tools.description:
Acknowledge an agent monitoring alert.

        Args:
            alert_id: UUID of the alert.

tools.name: detect_agent_monitoring_alert
tools.description:
Run agent monitoring detection on provided content.

        This is useful for testing alert rules or manually triggering playbook
        alerts.

        Args:
            content: Conversation or transcript text to analyze.
            analysis_id: Optional analysis UUID to associate alerts with.
            conversation_id: Optional conversation ID to associate alerts with.
            agent_name: Optional agent name to tag the alert with.

tools.name: list_recommendations
tools.description:
List business-profile-driven recommendations for the workspace.

        Recommendations may include suggested playbooks, integrations, and
        actions based on the workspace's business context.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description:
List agents in the workspace.

        Args:
            workspace_id: Optional workspace UUID. Uses the active workspace
                from the API key if not provided.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description:
Get details about a specific agent.

        Args:
            agent_id: UUID of the agent.

tools.name: get_agent_runtime
tools.description:
Get runtime status for an agent.

        Args:
            agent_id: UUID of the agent.

tools.name: provision_agent_runtime
tools.description:
Provision a runtime for an agent.

        Args:
            agent_id: UUID of the agent.

tools.name: republish_agent_runtime
tools.description:
Republish/redeploy an agent runtime.

        Args:
            agent_id: UUID of the agent.

tools.name: set_agent_secret
tools.description:
Set a secret on an agent's runtime.

        Args:
            agent_id: UUID of the agent.
            secret_name: Name of the secret.
            secret_value: Secret value.

tools.name: list_upcoming_meetings
tools.description:
List upcoming calendar meetings synced for the workspace.

        Returns Google Calendar events in the next 48 hours, including their
        auto-join status and selected playbook/scenario.

tools.name: set_meeting_auto_join
tools.description:
Enable or disable auto-join for a specific Google Calendar event.

        Args:
            google_event_id: The Google event ID (from `list_upcoming_meetings`).
            auto_join: True to have the meeting bot join automatically.
            scenario_id: Optional UUID of the playbook/scenario to run.

tools.name: sync_calendar
tools.description:
Force an immediate sync of the workspace's Google Calendar.

        Pulls the latest events from connected Google Calendar integrations into
        the upcoming_meetings table. The dispatcher also runs this automatically.

tools.name: get_calendar_settings
tools.description:
Get calendar auto-join settings and connected Google integrations.

        Shows which Google accounts are connected and whether they have calendar
        scope. No OAuth credentials are returned.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description:
List the workspaces this credential can access.

        Returns each workspace's id, name, slug, and the caller's role. An
        API key scoped to "all my workspaces" (the default) sees every
        workspace its owner belongs to; a workspace-scoped key sees exactly
        one. When more than one workspace is listed, pass the desired
        workspace's UUID to tools that accept a `workspace_id` argument
        (e.g. `list_agents`, `list_workspace_files`) to act outside the
        default workspace.
